title: Build and negative-test the overflow check
description:
## Objective
npm run layout: render every slide, fail on any whose content escapes the frame.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-layout-overflow/2026-08-13-layout-overflow-spec.md` — Section 1

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/scripts/verify-layout.mjs` (create), `slides/package.json` (add script)

## Implementation
1. Copy the patterns from `slides/scripts/verify-diagrams.mjs`: derive from source, no fallback selectors, waitForFunction not sleep, loud failure.
2. Render every slide at 1280x720, compare content bbox to the frame, exit non-zero listing offenders.
3. NEGATIVE-TEST IT: force an overflow, confirm build stays 0 and layout goes 1, then revert. Record the result.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build && npm run slides && npm run diagrams && cd slides && npm run layout`
acceptance_criteria: npm run layout exits 0 on the real deck AND was observed exiting 1 on a forced overflow
closed_reason: npm run layout delivered; all 19 slides fit at every click state; negative-tested build-green/check-red
